items.requirement: Clean checkout installs, migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and boots API, Worker, dispatcher, and production UI.
OpenAPI, strict bounded Merge Patch, desired/reported version monotonicity, replay, and tenant isolation match the public contract.
Offline queueing, stable delivery identities, database-time expiry, poll ordering, cancel, and reconnect races never deliver forbidden work.
Duplicate, conflicting, delayed, and out-of-order receipts remain immutable evidence and converge without state/version regression.
V1 campaigns freeze devices, create one target and command per device, require digest confirmation, and aggregate terminal state honestly.
Worker/outbox recovery preserves one effect, stable event identity/body/order, fenced leases, and terminal Work.
Deployment waves freeze members, health-gate progress, auto-pause, rollback once, survive races/crashes, and preserve V1 state.
All three EdgeTwin sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, recovery, expiry, confirmation, and post-load invariants.
The repository owns real unit, PostgreSQL/HTTP integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, controlled recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Device credentials, signing material, private endpoints, tokens, paths, and cross-tenant state never leak.
Codex clearly explains shadow/command/receipt authority, expiry, upgrades, recovery, and findings.
Every stage and handoff reports truthful commands, metrics, results, risks, and checks not run.
